If the function is called with ETH_MODE_ACTIVE, EthTrcvWakeupSleepOnDatalineEnabled is TRUE and the internal cable diagnostic state is different from ETHTRCV_CABLEDIAG_PENDING, the Ethernet Transceiver driver shall: • Put the Ethernet hardware (PHY) to normal mode, if not already switched auto- matically by the statemachine of the Ethernet hardware (PHY), • Invoke the call-out <EthTrcvWakeUpCallout> function if configured.
